name: multi-lounge
author: Antigravity
description: Auto-scaling voice lounges: clones a base channel when every lounge fills up and removes the extras when they empty, keeping numbering contiguous.
short: Voice lounges that scale with demand.
end_user_data_statement: Does not store any personal end-user data. Manages dynamic voice channels dynamically based on guild member occupancy without persisting user identities.
